Then reason: Qingzhen, Guizhou is located in the Northern Hemisphere monsoon region. The southern slope of the mountain, on the one hand, faces the sun and is a sunny slope, receiving more heat and having stronger evaporation; on the other hand, it faces the humid monsoon from the south or southwest and is the windward slope, with stronger precipitation and surface runoff erosion. In karst areas, the soil layer is thin, and after soil and water loss, rocks are more easily exposed, so rocky desertification is most serious on the southern slope.
